fields.statement: A table name supplied to a CopyMapper Add registration must be either an unqualified "table" or a schema-qualified "schema.table": it is non-empty, contains at most one period, and when it contains one, the schema part before it and the table part after it are both non-empty. Each part separately must be no more than 63 characters long (PostgreSQL's per-identifier NAMEDATALEN limit), must begin with a letter or an underscore, and must contain only letters, digits, underscores, or dollar signs. Any violation raises a plain System.Exception naming the specific rule broken before any destination-table or COPY command text is generated. A valid schema-qualified name is emitted into the generated CREATE TABLE and COPY text with each part quoted as its own identifier ("schema"."table"); an unqualified name is emitted as one quoted identifier ("table").
fields.scope: The tableName parameter of every CopyMapper Add registration (both the model-collection family and the virtual-compound-key family, across DatabaseBatch<TResult>, ShardBatch<TResult>, and ShardSetBatch), validated once per batch-step execution by ValidatePgTableName before the step body builds any command text, and quoted part-by-part by QuotePgTableName for the schema-qualified (persistent-table) path.

sources.label: ValidatePgTableName: at most one separator, both parts non-empty, per-part 63-character, leading-character and character-class rules
QuotePgTableName quotes each part as its own identifier
each copy step validates before building command text
schema-qualified path emits the part-quoted name
